posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
Benhimself:

Okay, going by "main" characters last names instead of promos, counting Fanatic as "H" for "Helena" because we don't know her last name (I could also see putting her first, under the principle that empty space is alphabetically first?)

I'd go with "H".  My mom is adopted, and there are many adoptees that have original birth certificates that have a blank entry for "name".  It can be a bit of a sore point.  Regardless of her "given" or "original" name, Fanatic is Helena.  I'm sure you were referring to the name as "(Blank last name), Helena," rather than "(Blank as a whole)", but I'd definitely go with her name rather than a blank space.  It just seems to be more in spirit of identifying characters by their "non-hero" names.

It's a rather minor point in the grand scheme of things, but I thought it might be worth mentioning!
